text:
چچالی بدل گجے
گاں دھنگیندا بھجے۔
romanized:
Chachali baddal gajje
Ga dhangénda bhajje.
literal_en:
If a cloud thunders in the north-west
A man should run while he hobbles his cow

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
